searchText: Is there live feed on merge progress? no live feed, but there is a live call by the community https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7eN8Qz8D8Eg Tks. What was the merge slot? Looks like #7382819 It seems so weird that all these popped up in the last testnet after past testnets and shadow forks 😅 Seems like we hit an edge case, which I guess is pretty valuable Really shows you that no matter how much testing you do you can’t find everything 😅 Fix one bug, another 10 will appear. Tale as old as time Yeah. I know nothing will change the sept merge date plus if I say anything people will just say I’m bias 😂 but seriously there needs to be 1 more major public testnet that’s not permissioned. Maybe one can be squeezed in. Shadow fork mainnet and existing nodes+validators can fork with it using a second instance and test merge? Isn't that basically mainnet shadow fork? Yeah pretty much but seems like shadow forks tend to be small and dev only Call it a merge pre run
